exposure: Maternal stress (measured by Parental Stressor Scale: Neonatal Intensive Care Unit)
outcome: Neurobehavioral indicators of preterm infants (measured by Neurobehavioral Assessment of the Preterm Infant)
Maternal stress levels (when predicted by infant neurobehavioral indicators)
cohort: The study included 165 preterm and low birth weight infants of both genders and their mothers hospitalized in a neonatal intensive care unit.
finding: Maternal stress levels were significantly correlated with low scores on neonatal neurobehavioral indicators, and specifically, low leg tone and limited arm movement were identified as predictors of higher maternal stress.
cross-section timing: during hospitalization in the neonatal intensive care unit
